name: Royal Historian Archesonus
summary: Royal Historian Archesonus is a dwarven scholar serving King Magni Bronzebeard within Ironforge's High Seat. Renowned for her scholarly works documenting recent catastrophes in the northern human kingdoms, she also directs research into ancient dwarven tragedies, notably the scorched remains of the Dark Iron kingdom.

sections.title: Chronicler of Catastrophe
sections.body: Stationed steps from King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat, Royal Historian Archesonus maintains historical records on behalf of the Ironforge crown. Her academic gaze extends well beyond the Khaz Modan mountains. She authored 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' as well as 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights,' tracking the horrific collapse of humanity's northern realm under the Scourge. Rather than hiding from dark histories, Archesonus approaches disasters methodically, seeking to record the truth of ruinous magic and political collapse.

sections.title: The Ashes of Thaurissan
sections.body: In addition to her texts on Lordaeron, Archesonus oversees inquiries into the War of the Three Hammers and the catastrophic fall of Emperor Thaurissan. Seeking recovered relics and charred tablets from the Burning Steppes, she enlists adventurers to search the Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan. For Archesonus, understanding the cataclysm that scorched the Burning Steppes and bound the Dark Iron clan to the Firelord is vital statecraft—ensuring the Bronzebeard kingdom remembers exactly what sorcery and desperation can unleash.

faq.q: Where can I find Royal Historian Archesonus?
faq.answer: Royal Historian Archesonus is located in the High Seat of Ironforge, just near King Magni Bronzebeard's throne room.

faq.q: What books did Royal Historian Archesonus write?
faq.answer: She is the author of 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' and 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights,' documenting the downfall of the human north and the necrotic afflictions spread by the Scourge.

faq.q: Why is Archesonus interested in the Ruins of Thaurissan?
aliases: why does she want ruins of thaurissan
faq.answer: She studies ancient dwarven history and sends scouts into the Burning Steppes to recover lost relics from the Ruins of Thaurissan, piecing together the catastrophe that destroyed the ancient Dark Iron capital.

faq.q: What is her role in Ironforge?
faq.answer: As the official Royal Historian, she acts as chief chronicler and archivist for King Magni Bronzebeard, compiling records on both dwarven antiquity and broader world events threatening the Alliance.

angles.text: Archesonus curates the official memory of your people, preserving painful lessons from the War of the Three Hammers so the Bronzebeard clan does not repeat the hubris of the Dark Irons.
Her academic works preserve the grim testimony of Lordaeron's fall, ensuring southern allies understand the nature of the plague and the forces that broke humanity's northern kingdoms.
